name: V1
summary: Ready for a real, shippable v1. The design layer MATURES here (PRINCIPLES.md #3) — it now turns on at MVP, where `designer`, /design-review and /ux-check moved in v0.189.0 (DEC-005). What V1 adds is the part that needs a real component set to exist first: design-drift-loop enforcement, /board for cross-FEAT sequencing, and /design-library — the visual system you can actually look at: one self-contained HTML page with the foundations, the RULE SETS (principles+tradeoffs, rendered do/don't pairs, terminology, voice) and every component in all five states, generated from the code so it cannot drift, with a manifest that doubles as the agent's reuse index and a source-hash staleness check; drift renders ON the component instead of in a report nobody reopens. V1 seats NO agents, and that is deliberate rather than a gap (DEC-006, v0.189.0): the raise-and-story mentors merged into `mentor-capital` at MVP, whose remit WIDENS here instead — the raise question and the investor story become live at V1 because real users finally make them answerable. Nothing installs; the coach you already have gets deeper. V1 is a skills rung. Two others used to land here and were re-runged in v0.189.0: business went DOWN to MVP (it belongs beside /money), talent went UP to Scale (first-hire questions belong where an org exists). The V1 intake had been four mentors arriving at once, half of them pre-defaulted to “not yet”.
graduationHint: When the team grows, the org gets real, and the product council needs to be a thing — boss unlock scale.
